title: Amazon API Gateway to AWS Lambda to Amazon DynamoDB
description: Make a request to API Gateway that saves data in DynamoDB.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern demonstrates how making an HTTP POST request to an Amazon API Gateway endpoint invokes an AWS Lambda function and inserts an item into an Amazon DynamoDB table.
